dedupe_keys.name: en ny sfarisk ljusfaltsdatabas for immersiva telekommunikations och telepresenceapplikationer

description: En ny sfärisk ljusfältsdatabas för immersiva telekommunikations- och telepresenceapplikationer is a dataset listed in Sweden's data portal, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Mittuniversitetet. This database is created by the Realistic 3D research group at Mid Sweden University, Sundsvall, Sweden. The database details are explained thoroughly in the publication which was published at the 16th International Conference on Quality of Multimedia Experience (QoMEX) in 2024. This database was also reviewed as part of the submission and publication process. Coverage: Mittuniversitetet. The portal shows the English title as "A New Spherical Light Field Database for Immersive Telecommunication and Telepresence Applications" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Mittuniversitetet. Its keywords include light field compression, telepresence, omnidirectional, Machine learning, view synthesis, Telecommunications. The listing shows 2025-08-11 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-oppnadata.
